outcome.answer: The closest matches are [1] and [2]. [1] compares legal-domain fine-tuning of multilingual embedding models and finds consistent retrieval gains across low- and high-resource languages, with cross-lingual transfer to unseen languages. [2] compares a base retriever, a legal-only fine-tuned model, and a mixed legal-plus-general setup, showing a trade-off between stronger specialization and better robustness across different legal search types and an out-of-domain benchmark.
